_note: EAR1 try-on test. Coords = pixels in the 1024x2304 transparent cut-out. place: item drawn with its top-centre anchor at pt, height = item.h*scale. occ: occluder = a piece cut from the SAME figure (hands/sleeve cuffs, cheek) drawn ABOVE the items, so items pass behind it. Layer order: figure -> items -> occluders. Anchors by eye on 3x zoom crops with a pixel ruler, corrected after 2x renders. Occluder masks: skin colour threshold (hands, cheek) + hand-placed polygons along the sleeve-cuff inner edges (c22). Built by make_occ.py.
